topography.project_purpose: Uncollateralized Lending. Structurally: 36 project-authored contract(s) across 4 chain(s); 4 ERC20 tokens, 2 ERC721 NFTs; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 3 functional families. Its contracts share 5 common project-authored base contract(s) (whitelistable, controller, contextupgradeable). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
